nodes.label: CI-Enforced Issue References
nodes.rationale: Local commit hooks and core.hooksPath do not travel with clones, so CI checks the issue-reference rule for every contributor and web UI commit.

nodes.label: Self-Deploying Game
nodes.rationale: Pushing to main builds and ships the game to its own Cloudflare origin.

nodes.label: Isolated Game Origin
nodes.rationale: A separate hostname prevents game changes from redeploying the content site and prevents a broken game build from blocking that site.

nodes.label: Kid-Safe by Construction
nodes.rationale: With no analytics, accounts, notifications, or post-load network requests, the game collects nothing and therefore has nothing to disclose.

nodes.label: Zero-Text Contract
nodes.rationale: Spatial affordances must carry the game loop; if words are required, the interaction design is considered broken.

nodes.label: Animation as Product
nodes.rationale: The art is intentionally simple, so motion quality and immediate interaction feedback provide the product's slickness.

nodes.label: Skin as Data
nodes.rationale: The engine must remain product-agnostic; if a second skin requires engine changes, the abstraction is defective.

nodes.label: Fragment Locality Privacy
nodes.rationale: Encoding the save in a URL fragment enables native iOS camera scanning without camera permission while keeping the save payload from reaching a server.
